title: Tailwise Autoship Patron Share on Late-Delivery Fee Refunds
content:
**Member benefit statement - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

A late-delivery fee refund carries an Autoship-patron share, added to the refund share, that counts whole months since the enrollment date of the customer's active Tailwise Autoship subscription.

| Whole months since enrollment of the active Tailwise Autoship subscription | Autoship-patron share added |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 5% |
| 12 or more, but fewer than 36 | 2.5% |
| Fewer than 12, or no active Autoship subscription | Nothing |

A month counts as whole once the day of the month of the enrollment date is reached again. Only a subscription in status active on the Tailwise Autoship record is read.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, today 2026-04-20).** Enrolled 2023-04-21: 35 months, 2.5%. Enrolled 2023-04-20: 36 months, 5%. Enrolled 2025-04-21: 11 months, nothing. Enrolled 2025-04-20: 12 months, 2.5%.
